يستقطع (form X)
# يَسْتَقْطِعُ (yastaqṭiʕu) /jas.taq.tˤi.ʕu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
# يُسْتَقْطَعُ (yustaqṭaʕu) /jus.taq.tˤa.ʕu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
# يَسْتَقْطِعَ (yastaqṭiʕa) /jas.taq.tˤi.ʕa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَقْ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
